title: MissionLifecycleBase
description: Property definitions shared by every Mission Measurement adapter's Record (#305, recorded in ADR-0010): nav2's NavigateToPose/NavigateThroughPoses/FollowWaypoints adapters and Open-RMF. Not a validatable schema on its own -- referenced via allOf/$ref by each adapter's own schema, which adds its own mission_type/required/conditional rules on top.

event.description: Which boundary of the mission this Record reports

mission_id.description: This adapter's identifier for the mission -- an action goal UUID for the nav2 adapters, Open-RMF's booking.id for its adapter

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing number of this Record, across every mission this Measurement instance has seen (not per mission_id), so a dropped Record is detectable

outcome.description: How the mission ended -- see the adapter's own schema for what maps to which value

reason.description: Human-readable detail on why the mission ended the way it did, when the source provided one

error_code.description: The source's own numeric error code, carried through verbatim, when it provided one

duration_sec.description: How long the mission ran, from its mission_start boundary to its mission_end boundary
